ads.headline: Meta Ads interest surging; service businesses should capitalize now before competition rises
actions: Launch a test campaign today targeting local service keywords before CPCs climb
Create 3-5 simple before/after videos for your service niche to stand out
Set up conversion tracking on all landing pages to capture the influx of cheaper clicks
ads.source: Google Trends spike: Meta Ads interest 42 (vs historical average ~25) + r/FacebookAds volume surge

creative.headline: Can't generate strategy—no engagement data provided this week
actions: I need actual performance data: which posts got most saves/shares/DMs, what captions drove 'ADS' comments, audience demographics, posting times that worked
Video idea placeholder: Once you share THIS WEEK's top 3 posts + their metrics, I'll give you the exact hook, script, and angle that's resonating with plumbers/landscapers right now

Avoid guessing—the Google Trends data shows all zeros, meaning either the data didn't sync or these terms aren't searchable. Share your Instagram Insights screenshot instead (reach, saves, profile visits, DM clicks)

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
